review.images: Eight native images sourced to physical pages in the original ELO brochure, with the dusk elevations as the lead. DAMAC uses some of the same interior and amenity renders for later ELO phases.
review.location: The ELO website marker is also published for ELO 2 and ELO 3. The branded ELO site map and named directions avoid asserting an exact entrance. The brochure shows 25 minutes to Dubai Outlet Mall and 35 to DXB, while the website lists 15 and 45 minutes respectively.
review.floorPlans: Eleven complete sheets from the original ELO brochure cover 12 layouts. All plan titles and sellable areas were visually verified, including the shared A4 and B1 spread.
